messages:
sam: Heads-up: we need a minimal telemetry contract for continuous-batching metrics to feed the new Console panel + alerting. Focus: batch size distribution, wait-time percentiles, queue saturation signals. Need runtime/infra owners to agree on names/labels by EOD tomorrow. CC @maria @raj @lee

maria: Got it. From runtime side I can emit histograms for batch_size and wait_ms. Thinking metric names: `runtime.batch.size` (histogram) and `runtime.batch.wait_ms` (histogram). Add labels: model, route, shard_id. Thoughts?

raj: Platform prefers snake_case with dot prefix for subsystem: `runtime.batch_size_hist`, `runtime.batch_wait_ms_hist` — but happy to adapt. We need consistent label set; avoid `shard_id` if low-cardinality explosion. maybe `pool` instead.

lee: Infra: we can also emit `queue.depth` gauges per pool and `queue.saturation_ratio` (0-1). For saturation, calculated as `inflight / capacity`. Would prefer labels: pool, node_role. Also we want a `queue.latency_p95_ms` derived from histogram client-side.

olivia: Console UX: panel needs p50/p95/p99 for wait_ms and batch_size distribution as percentiles + heatmap for queue saturation over time. Also a per-route sparklines + an alert if p95 wait_ms > 200ms for 5m.

sam: Agree on alerts. Can we standardize: metric names with prefix `redwood.`? e.g., `redwood.runtime.batch.wait_ms` hist. Platform/console can map to whatever view.

maria: Prefix fine. Revised names: `redwood.runtime.batch.size` hist, `redwood.runtime.batch.wait_ms` hist. Labels: `model`, `route`, `pool`. We'll push to dogstatsd/exporter by EOD.

maria: Example prometheus exposition we plan to emit:
```
# exemplars
redwood_runtime_batch_wait_ms_bucket{le="0.1",model="gpt4r",route="gen",pool="p1"} 42
redwood_runtime_batch_wait_ms_sum{model="gpt4r",route="gen",pool="p1"} 1234
redwood_runtime_batch_size_bucket{le="1",model="gpt4r",route="gen",pool="p1"} 100
```

raj: Small ask: include `deployment` label (can be `dedicated|hosted|private`) — helps filtering in Console. Also we need `route_version` optional label for rollouts.

lee: Note: for node-level capacity we need to avoid high-cardinality from `route_version`. make `route_version` optional and only set during canaries. Also we'll emit `redwood.infra.queue.saturation` gauge.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry-config-service updated mapping for `redwood.runtime.batch.*` -> prometheus job 'runtime-metrics' at 1772345805

sam: Thanks. Action items: maria to PR metric names + exemplar prometheus config; lee to add queue gauges and capacity; raj to update platform ingestion and mapping; olivia to mock panel JSON and alert rules. Filing a short RFC in #eng-docs. Ping here when done.

maria: :thumbsup: adding initial config in `metrics/telemetry-contracts/runtime_batching.yaml` in my PR.

raj: I'll slot a migration job to convert old `runtime.batch_wait` metrics to the new names for 2 weeks.

olivia: Prototype dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/batching-kpis (work-in-progress) — will post screenshots.

sam: :white_check_mark: great. Next sync tomorrow 9:30am if anybody needs to walk through.
